# AFUVAI

> AFUVAI is a high-end, by-appointment luxury floral design studio based in Las Vegas, Nevada. Founded by designer Ami Nelson, AFUVAI specializes in bespoke wedding florals, luxury private and corporate event installations, hands-on floral-making classes, and signature bouquets delivered across the Las Vegas valley. AFUVAI does not operate a walk-in retail store; custom work is by appointment.

## Service Area
Las Vegas, Summerlin, Henderson, North Las Vegas, and venues across The Las Vegas Strip.

## Services & Starting Prices
- Wedding Floral Design — from $3,500
- Private & Corporate Event Florals — from $1,500
- Floral-Making Classes — seats from $125; private "host your own" floral events quoted to scope
- Signature Bouquets (online shop, delivered) — from ~$155
- Floral Subscriptions — coming soon

## What Makes AFUVAI Distinct
Built on a luxury hospitality background, AFUVAI pairs fully bespoke wedding and event design with hands-on floral classes and an online bouquet shop — a rare combination for a Las Vegas studio. Premium and rare blooms are sourced to order for every project.
